description: EU compliance checks for AI agents: sanctions, company, VAT ID, IBAN, email. Pay per call.
summary: EU compliance checks for AI agents: sanctions, company, VAT ID, IBAN, email. Pay per call.
offersHint: EU compliance checks for AI agents: sanctions, company, VAT ID, IBAN, email. Pay per call. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://validation-api.dropcoin.workers.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: validate_vatid_format
toolsPreview.description: Free EU VAT-ID FORMAT check (syntax only, no registry lookup), rate-limited per IP, no API key needed. For a live VIES registry check use the paid validate_vatid tool (5 credits).

toolsPreview.name: validate_email
toolsPreview.description: Validate an email address: syntax, disposable-domain check, MX record via DNS-over-HTTPS. Returns a deliverability verdict. 2 credits, requires an API key.

toolsPreview.name: validate_vatid
toolsPreview.description: Validate an EU VAT ID against the live VIES registry (format check first — an invalid format still costs the full price, it never reaches VIES but you got an answer). 5 credits, requires an API key.

toolsPreview.name: validate_iban
toolsPreview.description: Validate an IBAN (ISO 13616 check digits) incl. SEPA membership. 2 credits, requires an API key.

toolsPreview.name: screen_sanctions
toolsPreview.description: Screen a person or company against the official EU, US (OFAC SDN) and UK (OFSI) sanctions lists. Fuzzy name matching with an auditable reason per hit — review every hit yourself; a clean result is not legal clearance and covers no PEP data. 15 credits, requires an API key.

toolsPreview.name: verify_company
toolsPreview.description: Verify a business partner in one call: EU VAT registration (VIES), LEI register (GLEIF), IBAN checksum and country consistency — one verdict (pass|fail|inconclusive) with an auditable check log. Provide at least one of name, vatId, lei. Does not include commercial-register existence checks. 150 credits, requires an API key.
